chemistry-killer-07.material: For standard conditions (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol of gas = 22.4 L), di volume of mixed gas wey get methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) and carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) na 11.2 L and di mass na 16.4 g. Di atomic masses na H=1, C=12, O=16 and di Avogadro number na $N_A$. Wetin be di total number of atoms wey dey inside dis mixed gas?
chemistry-killer-07.thinking.0: Three States of Matter and Molecular Models
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: For standard conditions (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol of gas = 22.4 L), di volume of mixed gas wey get methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) and carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) na 11.2 L and di mass na 16.4 g. Di atomic masses na H=1, C=12, O=16 and di Avogadro number na $N_A$. Wetin be di total number of atoms wey dey inside dis mixed gas?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Step 1: Total moles = 11.2 L ÷ 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol → x + y = 0.5.
Step 2: Mass: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Substitute y = 0.5 − x: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16.4 → 28x = 5.6 → x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Step 3: Number of atoms: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ get 5 atoms per molecule → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ get 3 atoms per molecule → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Sum 1.9 mol of atoms = $1.9\,N_A$.
Answer: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Wrong answers: 1.5 na value wey assume say all na CO2, 2.5 na value wey assume say all na CH4, and 1.7 na value wey count only 4 H atoms for CH4)

chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
